name: Noble Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. The city wall is to the south, towering over
desc3: twenty feet above you. It is quiet and deserted here, due to the
desc4: proximity of the slums. Debris and garbage is piled up against the
desc5: walls, and here and there you can see a stray animal cowering in the
desc6: shadows. The street continues to the east and west.
